description: This bar chart illustrates the correlation between ChatGPT’s question answering performance and ground-truth versus generated answers, specifically comparing “PopGT” to “PopGe” and “RPopGT” to “RPopGe” across three categories: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “Movies”, “Songs”, and “Basketball”, in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “Correlation”, displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.7, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals.  For each category, there are four bars representing the correlation values: a light orange bar labeled “PopGT”, a lighter blue bar labeled “PopGe”, a darker blue bar labeled “RPopGT”, and a hatched dark blue bar labeled “RPopGe”.  In the “Movies” category, the “PopGT” bar extends to approximately 0.2, “PopGe” to roughly 0.08, “RPopGT” to about 0.34, and “RPopGe” to approximately 0.28.  For “Songs”, the bars have heights of approximately 0.05 for “PopGT”, 0.33 for “PopGe”, 0.58 for “RPopGT”, and 0.22 for “RPopGe”. In the “Basketball” category, the bars reach approximately 0.03 for “PopGT”, 0.12 for “PopGe”, 0.06 for “RPopGT”, and 0.26 for “RPopGe”. The bars are grouped by category, appearing adjacent to one another, and are not visibly emphasized or sorted by any particular order within each group.
